src.t: Malignant Melanoma and Skin Cancer: ABCDE, Breslow Thickness and Wide Excision

snip.t: A phyllodes tumour is a separate fibroepithelial neoplasm that needs wide excision.
Wide excision of all necrotic tissue until healthy, bleeding tissue is reached, including fascia, with free margins.
Never shave or curette a suspected melanoma, and do not do a wide excision before diagnosis (the depth is needed to plan the operation).
snip.s: Malignant Melanoma and Skin Cancer: ABCDE, Breslow Thickness and Wide Excision

snip.t: Thin melanomas (under 0.7 to 1 mm) are usually cured by wide excision (5-year survival over 95%).
snip.s: Malignant Melanoma and Skin Cancer: ABCDE, Breslow Thickness and Wide Excision

snip.t: A lumpectomy with wide excision to clear margins is performed along with axillary lymph node sampling that shows no metastases.
Hidradenitis suppurativa: apocrine areas, chronic; wide excision for advanced disease.
